name: Argus
author: Diego Peter
description: CPU, RAM, GPU, disk, network, battery, power, and temperature stats in the bar, with a full system panel: 2m/1h/24h history that survives restarts (the flight recorder), per-metric opt-in alerts with context snapshots, a filterable sortable process table, per-process GPU usage, drive SMART health, an alert hook for automation, and a GAME tab that configures your MangoHud in-game overlay live.

barWidget.description: Pick which system stats (CPU, RAM, GPU, disk, network, battery, temperatures) appear in the bar — reorderable, urgent-colored past thresholds. Click for the full panel: Home dashboard, 24h flight-recorder history, opt-in alerts with context snapshots, process table, power draw, and the in-game HUD's control room.

schema.label: Disk mount for the bar metric
schema.description: Mount point whose usage the bar's disk metric shows.

schema.label: Allow alert notifications
schema.description: Master switch over every alert. Individual alerts are off by default — toggle them on and set their thresholds in the panel's ALERTS tab.

schema.label: Run command on alert
schema.description: Shell command run on every fired alert (in addition to the notification); details arrive in ARGUS_ALERT_KEY/TEXT/CRITICAL/AT environment variables.
